steps.action: Navigate to the Reports module of boxName.
steps.data:
boxName: TC-3819
Box Module - Reports - Checking if tasks on the Milestones & Markers report are grouped if they have the same ID
steps.result: Reports module loaded correctly. There is Milestones&Markers report displaying.

There are 4 columns: 
NAME, END DATE, BASELINE, SOURCE.

Milestones are displayed in the folLowing order:

* Milestone 3 (to do)/ 02/Jan/23 / +25d / (empty field) 
* Milestone 3 (in progress)/ 02/Jan/23 / +25d / (empty field) 
* Milestone 1 (to do)/ 27/Jan/23 / 0d / (empty field)
* Milestone 1 (in progress)/ 27/Jan/23 / 0d / (empty field) 
* Milestone 4(to do)/ 01/Jan/25 / -705d / (empty field) 
* Milestone 2 (to do)/ 01/Jan/25 / (empty field) / (empty field) 
* Milestone 4(in progress)/ 01/Jan/25 / -705d / (empty field) 
* Milestone 2 (in progress)/ 01/Jan/25 / (empty field) / (empty field) 
* Milestone (basic task)/ 01/Jan/25/ (empty field) / Program 
* Milestone 4(done)/ 01/Jan/40 / -6183d / (empty field) 
* Milestone 2 (done)/ 01/Jan/40 / (empty field) / (empty field) 

Tree nodes are collapsed.

There is a Today marker placed in the right position between milestones. 

Today marker's name and End date are bold.

The Baseline is displayed in red colour if its value is less than 0. 

Tree node is not displaying for: Milestone (basic task)

There is scroll bar on the right side of the report.

steps.action: Click on tree node button next to milestoneName.
steps.result:
The tasks located under the node are presented:

* Milestone 3 (in progress)/ 02/Jan/23 / +25d / Agile Project
* Milestone 3 (in progress)/ 02/Jan/23 / +25d / Classic project
* Milestone 3 (in progress)/ 02/Jan/23 / +25d / Hybrid Project
* Milestone 3 (in progress)/ 02/Jan/23 / +25d / Program

The parent's row has the columns NAME, END DATE, BASELINE filled in the same way as its children.

The exception is the SOURCE column - it’s empty for the parent, but each child keeps its original Source field.

steps.action: Click again on tree node button next to milestoneName.
steps.result:
View is collapsed. 
Only parent row is visible.
